name: Sync Opportunities (create/update)
summary: Creates or updates opportunity records. One row per opportunity; the name field is required and externalOpportunityId ties the row to the CRM record.
whenToUse: When you want to push opportunity data (amount, notes, custom fields) from outside into Marketo's opportunity records. Up to 300 per call.

body.hint: One row per opportunity. name is required in every row; include externalOpportunityId (the CRM ID) for create, and marketoGUID or externalOpportunityId for update.

response.description: Per row: marketoGUID, status (created/updated/failed), and the row sequence number.

notes: The name field must not be null — Marketo rejects rows without it.
There's no lookupField like on leads; matching uses externalOpportunityId or marketoGUID.
Requires SFDC or Dynamics Sync on the instance.
